title.en: Cyber-grunge fashion film with VHS glitch
title.zh: 赛博废土时装片与 VHS 故障

description.en: Controls a night blaze fashion film of a platinum-blonde figure in a patent trench, textured with VHS glitch and scanlines.
description.zh: 控制夜火时装片：铂金金发、漆皮风衣主体，叠加 VHS 故障与扫描线质感。

prompt:
Platinum-blonde subject, black patent-leather trench, orange firelight across the coat. Nighttime blaze, black smoke.

VHS glitches, CCTV dropouts, 90s grain, scanlines, chromatic aberration, flash-to-white cuts.
